mapper.select: SELECT FROM postcards WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE is_public = 1 AND postcard_type = 'normal' AND status = 'sent' AND sender_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE postcard_type = 'drifting' AND status = 'sent' AND sender_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE recipient_input = #{recipientInput} AND status = 'sent' AND recipient_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sender_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE status = 'scheduled' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_at <= NOW() ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT FROM postcards WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM postcards WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{startOfDay} AND created_at < #{endOfDay}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO postcards (user_id, title, image_url, image_offset_x, image_offset_y, image_scale, image_rotation, aspect_ratio, canvas_width, canvas_height, stamp_id, recipient_input, is_public, postcard_type, elements, status, review_reason, scheduled_at, sender_deleted, recipient_deleted) VALUES (#{userId},#{title},#{imageUrl},#{imageOffsetX},#{imageOffsetY},#{imageScale},#{imageRotation}, #{aspectRatio},#{canvasWidth},#{canvasHeight},#{stampId},#{recipientInput},#{isPublic},#{postcardType},#{elements},#{status},#{reviewReason},#{scheduledAt},#{senderDeleted},#{recipientDeleted})
